opennyai_summary.facts:
The petitioner has filed an application before the respondent/the Environmental Engineer, Kerala State Pollution Control Board, Trivandrum, for consent for operating the food division of her firm.
The application was filed on 10.06.2014.
opennyai_summary.decision:
In such circumstance, the respondent shall consider the application, if necessary after conducting a physical inspection and after affording an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner and as also any other objectors, if any, within a period of two months from today.
The writ petition is disposed of.
